items.t: Apple Gets Win in User Data Court Case Against UK Government
items.d: A UK court has rejected the British government’s attempt to keep secret an order it sent to Apple Inc. seeking access to the encrypted data of customers.

items.t: Anthropic Investor Says IPO Sets New Benchmark for AI
items.d: Pegasus Tech Ventures CEO and Anthropic investor Anis Uzzaman discusses the artificial intelligence lab’s rapid growth, why its enterprise-focused business model could offer a long runway for expansion, and how Anthropic’s public debut could establish a new valuation benchmark for the broader AI industry. (Source: Bloomberg)

items.t: Reform’s Nick Candy Says UK Rules Are Fueling Exodus of the Rich
items.d: British property investor Nick Candy warned the UK is becoming less attractive due to tax and excessive regulations, fueling an exodus of the rich to places including Monaco, Italy and the UAE.

items.t: Alibaba Warns US Curbs Will Curtail Growth, AI Buildout Goal
items.d: Alibaba Group Holding Ltd. warned that US restrictions on China’s access to cutting-edge chips may curtail growth and impair its data center blueprint, underscoring the broader fallout for the country’s artificial intelligence leaders.

HD현대중공업은 지난달 충남 태안에서 500메가와트(㎿)급 해상풍력단지의 해상변전소 건설 계약을 맺었다. 한화오션은 지난 2월 풍력발전기 설치선(WTIV) 1척을 수주했고, 삼성중공업은 부유식 해상풍력 하부구조물을 개발했다. 인프라·철강·전선 업체들의 움직임도 활발하다. 두산에너빌리티와 유니슨은 대형 풍력터빈 상용화를 추진하고 있다. SK오션플랜트와 GS엔텍은 하부구조물 사업, LS전선과 대한전선은 해저케이블 시장을 공략하고 있다. 포스코 등 철강업체도 고품질 특수 철강재 수요가 늘어날 것으로 보고 투자를 강화하고 있다. 글로벌 빅샷들의 방한도 이어지고 있다. 중국 최대 풍력터빈 제조업체인 골드윈드의 차오즈강 부회장은 최근 한국을 찾아 국내 해상풍력 사업자들과 회동하고 관련 기업들을 방문했다. 골드윈드는 지난해 전 세계에서 29.3GW의 풍력터빈을 설치한 시장 점유율(17.3%) 1위 기업이다. 골드윈드는 지분 70%를 보유한 독일 벤시스를 통해 한국 시장을 두드리고 있다. 세계 최대 해상풍력 개발사인 덴마크 오스테드도 한국에 공을 들이고 있다. 지난 9월 라스무스 에르보에 최고경영자(CEO)가 한국을 처음 찾은 데 이어 이달에는 아만다 다쉬 그룹 개발총괄(CDO)이 방한했다. ◇ 흩어진 생산거점 모아야 업계에서는 한국이 경쟁력을 높이려면 덴마크 풍력단지처럼 생산시설을 집적하는 클러스터 구축이 필요하다는 지적이다. 국내 기업들은 타워와 하부구조물, 해저케이블 등 개별 기자재를 생산할 역량을 갖추고 있지만 생산거점은 전국에 흩어져 있다. 대형 기자재를 각각 제작한 뒤 항만이나 해상 현장으로 운송하는 과정에서 특수운송과 중간 야적, 반복 인양 등에 따른 추가 비용이 발생할 수 있다. 최근 HJ중공업과 제이오션중공업, 명운산업개발, 유니슨이 군산조선소를 해상풍력 제조 클러스터로 조성하기 위해 업무협약(MO

AI 기사요약 국내 해상풍력 시장의 성장 전망에 따라 글로벌 기업의 방한과 국내 제조업계의 선점 경쟁이 본격화되는 가운데, 시장 경쟁력 제고를 위한 제조 클러스터 구축 및 인허가·금융 지원 등 제도적 정비가 요구된다. 조선·철강·전선, 해상풍력 신사업 확대 제조 클러스터·인허가 개선이 성장 관건 덴마크와 중국 등 세계적인 풍력기업의 최고경영진이 잇따라 한국을 찾고 있다. 주춤하던 국내 해상풍력 시장이 확대될 것으로 전망되면서 발전사업부터 터빈 등 핵심 기자재까지 시장 선점 경쟁이 치열해지는 모습이다. 국내 조선·전선·철강업체도 해상풍력 사업 확대에 나섰다. 업계에서는 해상풍력 시장이 성장하려면 분산된 생산시설을 집적하는 제조 클러스터 구축과 인허가·금융 지원 등이 필요하다는 지적이 나온다. ○韓, 2040년 해상풍력 45GW로 확대 19일 업계에 따르면 중국 최대 풍력터빈 제조업체인 골드윈드의 차오즈강 부회장은 최근 한국을 찾아 국내 해상풍력 사업자들과 회동하고 관련 기업들을 방문했다. 골드윈드는 지난해 전 세계에서 29.3기가와트(GW)의 풍력터빈을 설치한 시장 점유율(17.3%) 1위 기업이다. 골드윈드는 지분 70%를 보유한 독일 벤시스를 통해 한국 시장을 두드리고 있다. 세계 최대 해상풍력 개발사인 덴마크 오스테드도 한국에 공을 들이고 있다. 지난 9월 라스무스 에르보에 최고경영자(CEO)가 한국을 처음 찾은 데 이어 이달에는 아만다 다쉬 그룹 개발총괄(CDO)이 방한했다. 오스테드는 인천 앞바다에서 총 1.47GW 규모의 해상풍력 발전사업을 추진하고 있다. 한경 프리미엄9의 모든 콘텐츠는 한국경제신문의 저작물로 저작권법의 보호를 받습니다. 사전 허가 없는 무단 전재·복제·배포·캡처 공유·AI 학습 활용 및 상업적 이용을 금합니다. 위반 시 서비스 이용 제한 및 민형사상 법적 책임이 발생할 수 있습니다. 무료 열람 혜택으로 기사를 읽으셨습니다. 한경 프리미엄9을 구독하고 무제한으로 만나보세요. 구독하기 AI 뉴스 Q&A 더 궁금한 점이 있으신가요? 읽으면서 머릿속에 맴돌던 질문들, 앨리스가 대답해 드릴게요. 인공지능(AI)을 활용해 생성되었으며, 일부 내용에 오류가 있을 수 있습니다. AI 포인트 뷰 이전 분석 종목 다음 분석 종목 본 서비스의 AI가 제공하는 종목 정보는 정보 제공 목적의 참고 자료일 뿐, 투자 권유·자문·추천에 해당하지 않습니다. 투자에 따른 손실 책임은 사용자에게 있습니다. 좋아요 싫어요 후속기사 원해요 신정은 기자 산업부에서 중공업 기사를 씁니다. 방산인사이트 출범! 제보 환영합니다. 안시욱 기자 산업부에서 중공업을 출입하고 있습니다. SK와 한화, HD현대, GS를 비롯한 제조업 기반 기업을 취재하고 있습니다. 조선과 방산, 정유, 석유화학, 철강, 항공, 해운, 에너지, 전력기기, 첨단소재 등의 소식을 전합니다. 서울대학교 정치학과를 졸업했습니다. 2022년 한국경제신문에 취재기자로 입사했습니다. 문화스포츠부와 정치부를 거쳤습니다. 제21대 대선 이후 (공저)을 썼습니다. 꼼꼼히 취재하고 알기 쉽게 쓰겠습니다. 관련 뉴스

Amid string of outages, bipartisan letter urges strategy to combat AI-assisted cyber threats
items.d: In the midst of a series of recent cyber outages, there is growing concern by members of Congress that the Trump administration needs to do more to protect infrastructure from cyberattacks that are aided by AI, according to a new bipartisan letter sent by two senators to the White House’s AI czar.

But the letter warns that U.S. defenses against AI-assisted attacks “are not keeping pace.” Listen to this article with a free profile 00:00 00:00 White House AI czar Jay Clayton. Aaron Schwartz / Getty Share Add NBC News to Google Nov. 18, 2026, 4:45 AM EST / Updated Nov. 18, 2026, 4:46 AM EST By Laura Strickler In the midst of a series of recent cyber outages , there is growing concern by members of Congress that the Trump administration needs to do more to protect infrastructure from cyberattacks that are aided by AI, according to a new bipartisan letter sent by two senators to the White House’s AI czar. The letter from U.S. Sens. Maria Cantwell from Washington state, the top Democrat on the Senate Commerce Committee, and Mike Rounds, the Republican from South Dakota who chairs the Senate Armed Services Committee Subcommittee on Cybersecurity, urges AI czar Jay Clayton to develop a new national strategy that addresses AI-assisted cyber threats. “AI is rapidly increasing the ability to discover and exploit weaknesses in software, and our defenses are not keeping pace,” the senators wrote. They noted that AI can quickly find vulnerabilities in software and get around regular cyber defenses. Repair patches that are supposed to protect infrastructure can take weeks or months to test and install. And they wrote that autonomous AI agents can introduce new security risks. The White House did not immediately respond to a request for comment Tuesday. items.t: Nvidia enters the post-Jensen Huang era with a bang
items.d: Nvidia delivered a message with its first earnings report under new leadership: The sky isn’t falling.
items.fullText: Artificial intelligence Nvidia enters the post-Jensen Huang era with a bang The company’s interim CEO delivered strong earnings and a clear message about the future of Nvidia without its charismatic former leader. Listen to this article with a free profile 00:00 00:00 NVIDIA says Jensen Huang will not return as CEO 01:47 Get more news Live on Share Add NBC News to Google Nov. 17, 2026, 9:41 PM EST / Updated Nov. 17, 2026, 9:42 PM EST By David Ingram Nvidia delivered a message with its first earnings report under new leadership: The sky isn’t falling. With a new CEO and board chair just days after the resignation of co-founder Jensen Huang, the company reported results Tuesday that beat analysts’ expectations for AI chip sales. Nvidia’s new leaders also appeared to calm some investors’ nerves about the immediate future of a company at the heart of the AI economy. Colette Kress, the interim CEO and Nvidia’s longtime chief financial officer, and Harvey Jones, the newly elected board chair, used the quarterly earnings call to answer many — but not all — of the biggest questions hanging over Nvidia, including who will be running things in the near term. Just hours before the earnings release, Huang had injected fresh uncertainty into precisely that question when announced that he would be “honored” to return to the job of CEO, if the company’s board decided to bring him back. items.fullText: Ian Buck Kicks Off NVIDIA’s Week at SC26 as Science Enters the Age of Agents At SC26, NVIDIA’s VP of Hyperscale and HPC laid out how researchers can combine simulation, AI and agents to accelerate scientific discovery. November 17, 2026 by Brian Caulfield 0 Comments Share Share This Article X Facebook LinkedIn Copy link Link copied! NVIDIA’s Ian Buck kicked off the company’s week at SC26 in Chicago on Monday with new tools for AI agents, software that can plan experiments, run code and check results on researchers’ own systems. In NVIDIA’s special address, Buck announced Nemotron for Science , the Rubin HPC GPU and an expanded Vera CPU platform for high-performance computing . He also detailed a new collaboration in quantum computing with IBM and Fermi National Accelerator Laboratory . “The frontier of computing and the new scientific stack is going to be simulation, as always, but combined with AI and the future of quantum,” said Buck, vice president of hyperscale and high-performance computing at NVIDIA. Buck opened the talk by looking back to his first public talk on CUDA, at an SC06 tutorial in Tampa, Florida, 20 years ago. NVIDIA now offers more than 1,000 CUDA-X libraries , he said. Open Models for Science Agents “[Agents] have been just a game changer in how we interface with our supercomputers, with our devices, our instruments and how we can do the research,” Buck said. Simulation remains the foundation of scientific computing, “which will always be on the top,” Buck said, with AI, quantum and now agents working alongside it. Nemotron for Science combines the Nemotron 3.5 Super VL open model with a new open chemistry dataset and post-training recipes for life sciences and chemistry, Buck explained. Researchers can run it locally on a DGX Spark, a workstation or their own supercomputer. items.fullText: NVIDIA Expands Slurm to Bring Quantum Computing Into Supercomputing Quantum hardware developers, software providers and supercomputing centers are adopting the community-built Slurm workloads manager and the NVIDIA quantum platform to integrate quantum processors, design future systems and develop scientific applications. November 16, 2026 by Sam Stanwyck 0 Comments Share Share This Article X Facebook LinkedIn Copy link Link copied! Quantum processor deployments at supercomputing centers have grown nearly sevenfold over the past five years, with nearly 30 supercomputing centers around the world now in the process of deploying over 50 quantum processors. Many of these centers use Slurm to run scientific supercomputing workloads, so expanding its support for quantum processors builds on familiar workflows and tools, enabling computational chemists, nuclear physicists and materials scientists to bring quantum computing into their research domains without friction. In a new release, Slurm builds on previous work with IBM, Pasqal and the wider quantum computing community to allow QPU builders to create a single interface to their hardware for every supercomputing center, through a simple file. This makes it easier than ever for HPC centers and QPU builders to integrate and serve their hardware. The expansion is already being adopted by Alice & Bob , IBM , IQM , Pasqal , Quantinuum and MQSC and supports the widely used QRMI and QDMI interfaces. Read All NVIDIA Announcements From SC26 Beating the Bottleneck Until now, integrating a QPU into a supercomputing center meant a new software challenge for every new QPU or supercomputing center. By building on existing quantum-HPC interfaces such as QRMI and QDMI, the Slurm expansion allows QPU builders to reuse their integrations across all their deployments. It also means that supercomputing centers can add new quantum processors to their existing scheduling and resource-management workflows without developing bespoke QPU-specif

items.fullText: NVIDIA Announces Rubin HPC — A New GPU to Accelerate Agents for Science, Engineering and Analytics A record leap in CUDA cores with accelerated data movement shorten time to results for science and engineering workloads. November 16, 2026 by Dan Ernst 0 Comments Share Share This Article X Facebook LinkedIn Copy link Link copied! Announced today at SC26, NVIDIA Rubin HPC is a new GPU in the NVIDIA Vera Rubin platform designed to accelerate simulation and data processing for science, engineering and analytics workflows. As agents help scientists and engineers explore more candidate materials, molecules and designs, they rely on simulations to test those ideas and guide their next steps. Rubin HPC will accelerate those simulations, shortening the path from exploration to scientific discovery and industrial design. The Rubin HPC GPU features a record number of CUDA cores — more than 50,000 on a single GPU — as well as a sparse data acceleration capability that keeps those cores fed with data, and accelerates GPU-to-GPU connectivity with seventh-generation NVIDIA NVLink interconnect technology. Read All NVIDIA Announcements From SC26 Scientists and engineers rely on simulation to understand complex systems before committing to experiments or physical prototypes. Working with agents, these teams can explore more candidate materials, molecules and designs. items.fullText: AI Day Seoul Brings Together Korea’s Industry Leaders, Startups and Developer Communities November 15, 2026 by NVIDIA Writers 0 Comments Share Share This Article X Facebook LinkedIn Copy link Link copied! Over two days at COEX, more than 2,000 attendees converged for AI Day Seoul, bringing together Korea’s industry leaders, startups and developer communities advancing physical AI and AI agents. At the plenary sessions, Deepu Talla, vice president of robotics and edge AI at NVIDIA, said Korea is “punching above its weight,” with Doosan Robotics, Hyundai Motor Group, LG Electronics and SK Group — as well as startups like Real World and Luda Robotics — using NVIDIA platforms to bring general-purpose robotics into the real world. Jonathan Cohen, vice president of applied research at NVIDIA, showed how enterprises can build agents they own and control. Breakout sessions featured speakers from Coupang Intelligent Cloud, Doosan Robotics, LG AI Research, LG Electronics, NAVER Cloud, SK Telecom and Upstage. “It was a genuinely enjoyable time to have candid conversations,” said Hyunho Yang, research engineer for omnimodal foundation models at SK Telecom. “Seeing the passion of fellow AI developers was a real source of inspiration for me.” Community leaders share how they build with open models and tools at AI Day Seoul. The Agentic AI 10x Bootcamp Community Day brought together Pseudo Lab, Python Korea, PyTorchKR, HAERAE, Hugging Face KREW, Graph User Group, Womxn Who Code Korea, Dnol (Datayanolja) and other developer communities. Five finalists from the Hangul Day hackathon, co-hosted with Fastcampus, built agents trained on the Korean language and culture with the OpenShell runtime. The winning team, FlyGate, received an NVIDIA DGX Spark system. More than 500 developers also took part in full-day NVIDIA Deep Learning Institute workshops and NVIDIA Certification exams in Korean. items.fullText: AI Is Helping Care Teams Get Patients the Right Care, Sooner Health systems and startups are using the latest AI technologies to support clinicians, streamline workflows and improve patient care. November 13, 2026 by NVIDIA Writers 0 Comments Share Share This Article X Facebook LinkedIn Copy link Link copied! From pediatric research to smart hospitals, AI is helping care teams spend less time on routine tasks and more time with patients. Health systems and startups are putting it to work across healthcare, from matching patients to clinical trials to supporting radiologists, hospital teams and patients at home. Clinicians stay at the center, reviewing AI outputs and guiding decisions, while NVIDIA technologies provide the compute behind the applications. Read on to learn how healthcare teams are using AI to improve and speed patient care. Tuesday, Nov. 17, 8:00 a.m. PT 🔗 Proximie Helps Surgical Teams Spend Less Time on Logistics and More Time With Patients As AI advances healthcare, surgery is a high-stakes, highly regulated setting for its use — and one with significant opportunity for efficiency gains. Only about 10% of time spent in the operating room is clinical. The rest is devoted to scheduling, turnover and documentation. With the help of NVIDIA technology, Proximie is introducing AI into operating room (OR) logistics so that clinicians can focus on taking care of patients. A New Vantage Point Proximie is using NVIDIA Cosmos 3 , the frontier open world foundation model family for physical AI, to power a platform used in more than 700 ORs today. Trained on a decade of data, it captures real-time audio, video and device signals from a close-up view of the surgery as well as a wide view of the whole room. The comprehensive view offers context held by no single person in the room, whether the surgeon, scrub nurse or coordinator. items.fullText: 해외소식 삼성전자, 독일서 ‘스마트 사이니지 플립’ 누적 판매 10만 대 달성 독일, 2026/11/09 AUDIO Play Download 공유 레이어 열기 인쇄하기 삼성전자가 독일 시장에서 인터랙티브 디스플레이 Flip Pro 전자칠판(WMFX 시리즈)가 누적 판매량 10만 대를 달성했다. 삼성전자는 지난 4일(현지시간) 독일 프랑크푸르트 인근 카르벤(Karben)에 위치한 직업교육기관 ‘BBW 쥐트헤센(BBW Südhessen)’에서 기념식을 열고, 10만 번째 Flip Pro 제품을 전달했다. 해당 제품은 4K UHD 터치 디스플레이로, 특수교육기관의 디지털 학습과 직업훈련에 활용될 예정이다. 2018년 처음 출시된 스마트 사이니지 플립은 현재 5세대까지 진화한 삼성전자의 인터랙티브 디스플레이다. 종이 플립차트를 대체하는 디지털 화이트보드에서 출발해 직관적인 사용자 인터페이스와 슬림한 디자인을 바탕으로 교육기관과 기업, 공공기관 등 다양한 분야에서 활용되고 있다. BBW 쥐트헤센은 특수교육 직업훈련과 취업, 자립을 돕는 교육기관이다. 현재 약 500명의 청년이 30개 이상의 직종에서 직업훈련을 받고 있으며, 약 250명이 진로 탐색 프로그램에 참여하고 있다. BBW 쥐트헤센은 수년간 삼성전자 디스플레이를 직업교육과 진로 탐색 프로그램은 물론, 교직원 세미나와 회의 등 다양한 교육·업무 환경에서 활용해 왔다. 이번에 전달된 Flip Pro 전자칠판(WMFX 시리즈)역시 청년들의 직업교육과 디지털 역량 강화를 지원하는 데 활용될 예정이다. 독일 뉴스룸 기사 원문 보기 삼성전자 뉴스룸의 직접 제작한 기사와 이미지는 누구나 자유롭게 사용하실 수 있습니다. 그러나 삼성전자 뉴스룸이 제공받은 일부 기사와 이미지는 사용에 제한이 있습니다. 삼성전자 뉴스룸 콘텐츠 이용에 대한 안내 바로가기 해외소식 더보기 다운로드 닫기 다운로드 할 자료가 없습니다. 본문 복사하기 본문이 복사되었습니다. 공유하기 닫기 페이스북 X 링크드인 카카오톡 메일 라인 복사할 주소 주소복사
